notes.title: ⚠ Long-awaited update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43676348/b7eb3e1c187d634368de844c4054aa6ca8d52609.png
👉 How to give access to your editor
1) You need to go to the Menu - > My Property
2) Open the settings at the location to which you want to give access
3) At the very bottom, enter the nickname of the player to whom you allow access to the editor and click the "Plus" button

notes.title: Chat update
notes.content: Click on chat message to paste sender's name into message edit field.

notes.title: 💥 Lots of new products and updates this Friday!
notes.content:
👉 What's in store for us?
- New animated gifts.
- Cool update of water pistols.
- New pair dance! Very beautiful and romantic.
- New accessories!
- Improved and improved appearance of dragons, new colors, as well as a new animation "Breathe fire".

❗Now every Friday releases and updates! Follow the news!
